title: Helwit Orange Nicotine Pouches 9mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Orange Nicotine Pouches offer a bright, citrus-forward flavour that’s both tangy and smooth. The taste captures the essence of ripe Orange with a rounded sweetness that lingers gently on the senses. It’s a refreshing departure from the usual mint profiles, offering something a little fruitier without being overpowering. Each pouch contains 9mg of nicotine, making it a solid choice for regular users who want satisfying nicotine delivery in a discreet format. Made from soft plant-based fibres, the slim pouches are comfortable to wear and release nicotine gradually, without any smoke, vapour or odour. Clean, portable and refreshingly different. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
